title: Annual update
description: Ask partners to confirm their contact details and share an update. Answers can be reviewed and applied to their record.

survey.title: Annual update
survey.intro: Once a year we like to make sure we have your details right and hear what has changed. Please leave anything blank that is still correct.

questions.label: Best phone number to reach you
Best email address to reach you
How do you prefer to be contacted?
A recent photo of you and your family (optional)
A short update on your work for the people who pray for you
Anything else that has changed (family, location, plans)?
